verdicts.title: Galois and Cartan Cohomology of Real Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Real forms of a complex reductive group are classified by Galois cohomology H^1(Gamma,G_ad) where G_ad is the adjoint group. Cartan's classification of real forms in terms of maximal compact subgroups can be stated in terms of H^(Z/2Z,G_ad) where the action is by a (holomorphic) Cartan involution. The main result is that for any complex reductive group, possibly disconnected, there is a canonical isomorphism between H^1(Gamma,G) and H^1(Z/2Z,G).
